_note: Input definitions of the starting knowledge base: how the calculator asks for each piece of data the rules read. Kept as a data file, not code; definitions of new data arrive with the approved update that first reads it. Fields: key (bucket.key read by the rules), label, help, type (money|int|bool|choice|flag|text), group (employee|employer|monthly), order, core (always shown), repeat (monthly data: repeats every month), increment, default, options / options_from (table:<name> or usage), labels (display texts of table keys), show_if, valid_from, valid_until, replaces, optional, source.

defs.label: PTKP status on 1 January
defs.help: TK = not married, K = married; the number = number of dependants. The status on 1 January applies for the whole year; marrying or having a child during the year takes effect the next year.

defs.label: Sex
defs.help: Used by the PTKP rule for married female employees.

defs.label: Statement that the husband has no income
defs.help: A married female employee uses the PTKP of an unmarried person, unless she has this statement.

defs.label: How the tax is paid
defs.help: Gross: withheld from the salary. Gross-up: the employer pays a tax allowance equal to the PPh 21. Employer-borne: the employer pays the tax without an allowance.

defs.label: NIK / NPWP registered
defs.help: A condition of the DTP incentive.

defs.label: Employee is also a shareholder
defs.help: A company car used by a shareholder is always a taxable benefit in kind.

defs.label: Average monthly gross income, last 12 months
defs.help: A company car is taxable when this average is above the limit. Empty: the base salary + fixed allowance of that month is used.

defs.label: Fixed income under the contract
defs.help: For new employees: the DTP income limit uses the fixed income in the employment contract.

defs.label: Already receives another DTP incentive
defs.help: If yes, this DTP does not apply.

defs.label: Became a taxpayer in Indonesia in (month)
defs.help: Only for employees who came from abroad this year; their tax is annualised.

defs.label: Stopped being a taxpayer in Indonesia in (month)
defs.help: Only for employees who moved abroad or died this year.

defs.label: Last working month, already certain
defs.help: For employees who are certain to leave.

defs.label: Line of business (KLU, 5 digits)
defs.help: The business classification code (KLU) of the company; decides eligibility for the DTP incentive.

defs.label: Work risk (JKK)
defs.help: The risk level that sets the JKK premium rate.

defs.label: Eligible for JKK contribution relief
defs.help: Certain labour-intensive industries.

defs.label: BPJS contributions as billed
defs.help: If yes, contributions and premiums are entered each month as billed by BPJS; if not, they are computed from the wage.
defs.source: how the app reads payroll data

defs.label: Value of meals at the workplace
defs.help: For the limit on meal coupons for field duty.

defs.label: Eligible for the 2020 BPJS contribution relief
defs.source: BPJS contribution relief during the pandemic

defs.label: Base salary
defs.help: The base salary paid that month (already prorated when the employee joins, leaves, or gets a raise in the middle of the month).

defs.label: Fixed monthly allowance
defs.help: An allowance paid at a fixed amount every month, e.g. a position, family, phone, or transport allowance.

defs.label: Overtime pay
defs.help: Overtime pay paid that month. Under the regulation it counts as regular income even though the amount varies.

defs.label: Other regular pay (meal money, cash transport, etc.)
defs.help: Other pay paid regularly, e.g. daily meal money or cash transport.

defs.label: THR
defs.help: The religious holiday allowance (THR) paid that month.

defs.label: Bonus
defs.help: The bonus paid that month.

defs.label: Occasional incentive, compensation, or back pay
defs.help: Pay that is not paid regularly, e.g. a quarterly sales incentive, compensation, or back pay after a salary raise.

defs.label: Other salary deductions
defs.help: Deductions other than tax and contributions (loans, fines).
defs.source: how the app reads payroll data

defs.label: Employee JHT contribution (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Employee JP contribution (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Employee BPJS Kesehatan contribution (bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: JKK premium (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the premiums follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: JKM premium (BPJS bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the premiums follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Employer BPJS Kesehatan contribution (bill)
defs.help: Filled in when the contributions follow the BPJS bill.

defs.label: Company car (monthly value)
defs.help: The value of using the company car for a month. Taxable only in certain cases; the rules decide.

defs.label: Company housing for one employee (monthly value)
defs.help: The monthly value of the company housing.

defs.label: Gift parcel outside religious holidays
defs.help: The value of the parcel received that month.

defs.label: Meal coupon for field duty
defs.help: The value of meal coupons for employees on field duty.

defs.label: Sports facility
defs.help: The value of the sports facility received that month.

defs.label: Other goods or facilities (benefits in kind)
defs.help: Other benefits in kind received, e.g. a scholarship from the company.

defs.label: Zakat through the employer
defs.help: Zakat or a mandatory religious donation withheld through the employer that month.

defs.label: THR paid this month
defs.help: Tick the month the THR is paid (not the month of the holiday). Used to check the minimum THR and by company policies that compute the THR.

defs.label: Length of service (months)
defs.help: Continuous service up to that month, in months. Sets the minimum THR (one month's wage for 12 months of service or more, proportional below that).

defs.label: Days since leaving before the holiday
defs.help: Filled in only when the employee left within 30 days before the religious holiday; they still have a right to THR.
